text:
alex: Quick thread for the relnotes + changelog parity sweep before tomorrow's publish. Scope: short changelog bullets for the release, confirm snippet parity across SDKs, and decide whether to call out the Dedicated 503s in the main release page or just in the known issues section.
mona: I'll draft the three bullets and a slightly longer paragraph for the detailed relnotes. We should mention 'route policy (beta)' and 'prefix cache v2' and note SDK breaking-surface is minimal.
vic: I'm running a quick snippet audit. Found a Rust example still using old `Client::new()` signature; new API is `Client::with_options(...)`. Will open PR. Also JS and Python are mostly compatible but one Python sample uses `cache_mode = 'legacy'`.
alex: Good catch. Keep the relnotes terse; link to the migration guide for the diff. No long examples inline.
tim: I'll run linkcheck+snippet-lint after PRs land. Regarding the Dedicated 503s: Ops suggests a one-line known issue saying "some Dedicated clusters see transient 503s during GPU warmup; retry after 30s" and link to status page. That should be enough.
mona: Draft bullets: - Route policies (beta): choose routing preference (latency, cost, region) to control where requests run; automatic fallbacks protect critical paths. - Prefix cache v2: faster cold-starts and improved memory efficiency; one-line migration available. - Snippet updates: small SDK API adjustments across Rust/Go/Python/JS; examples refreshed. Known issue: Some Dedicated clusters may briefly return 503s during GPU warmup; retrying after ~30s typically succeeds.
vic: PRs: #1601 (rust snippets), #1602 (py), #1603 (js). Kept changes tiny. I also updated links in the snippet index.
docs-bot: deploy-bot: branch docs/relnotes-6101234567 deployed to staging; site build passed with two l10n warnings.
l10n-bot: automated: Warnings: cropped screenshots mismatch in fr and es locales; missing anchor /fr/guides/cache#migration. See #1620.
alex: For the localized screenshots note, add a short known-issue line: "A subset of localized screenshots may show old UI text; updated images are in progress." Keep it non-alarming.
mona: OK adding that line. Also adding homepage blurb draft: "Try route policies (beta) and faster prefix cache v2  see release notes." Short.
tim: After snippet PRs merge I'll re-run linkcheck. If anchors still fail we'll add temporary redirects. Also will verify that the status page link is up for the Dedicated 503 note.
vic: Merged snippet PRs. Quick smoke: snippet-lint clean, tiny formatter tweak in Rust.
docs-bot: deploy-bot: re-deployed branch docs/relnotes-6101234567; build succeeded; only localization warnings remain.
alex: Final plan: mona finalizes copy, tim adds redirect for missing anchor if needed, alex merges and publishes. Target: 08:45 PT. If any post-publish dust-ups open a thread and tag me + ops.
mona: Merged relnotes and updated content/home.md with the homepage blurb. Monitoring build and l10n issues. Thanks everyone.
